Priya (CS): Quick recap from today's all-hands Q&A — thread to capture follow-ups about customer wins/losses and top asks. Posting the high-level reasons we heard and action items so we can assign owners.
Morgan (CEO): Thx Priya. Top themes we heard: 1) compliance/data residency, 2) integration complexity and onboarding time, 3) unpredictable cost per unit / token economics. Also a few calls about latency at scale.
Raya (Sales): Can we get concrete examples so AE owners can follow up? Which deals cited cost vs compliance vs latency?
Morgan (CEO): Quick examples: FinReg (lost) — compliance + required VPC/on-prem; RetailX (won but later churn risk) — latency spikes during peak traffic; ChatStart (lost) — pricing and absence of prebuilt connector to their stack.
Alex (Product): From product side the #1 ask was an onboarding playbook + ready connectors. Also folks want clearer docs on Dedicated vs Private differences (cost + ops).
Jonas (Eng): On latency: we have a few low-effort wins — better batching defaults and prefix caching; we should document recommended configs per workload.
Sam (Research): Sales asked whether quantized model variants were a reason for losses? Do we have clear guidance on accuracy vs cost tradeoffs?
Alex (Product): Good call. Action: produce a short "accuracy vs cost" cheat sheet for common models and quantization profiles. Owner: Alex. ETA EOW. :memo:
Priya (CS): Action: Compliance onboarding kit (checklist, required docs, network templates). Owner: Priya + Security. ETA 2 weeks.
Raya (Sales): I'll pull anonymized loss notes into the kit — will post to this thread when done.
Jonas (Eng): I'll add a draft latency playbook that includes autoscale configs, batching, and recommended kernel profiles. Will link benchmarks.
ci-bot: Created issue #CI-3421: "all-hands: customer loss playbook / onboarding kit" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/3421)
Morgan (CEO): Please link the ticket to the sales notes and assign next steps in the issue. Prioritize the compliance kit and the latency playbook.
Priya (CS): Will do. Scheduling a 30m follow-up retro next Wed 10am to review drafts and owners. Invite: @here.
Raya (Sales): Ack — I'll add the anonymized examples.
Sam (Research): If helpful I can run a quick eval on quantized variants against the loss cases and post results.
Alex (Product): Yes please, Sam. That'll feed the cheat sheet.
Morgan (CEO): Thanks everyone — let's aim to have those org-level artifacts ready before the next roadmap review. :rocket:
